text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

BANGLADESH, Dec 3 - Chittagong - 11 Vessels in port of which 4 containers, 2 general cargo, 1 fertiliser, 1 food grain, 1 cement clinker, 2 others. 24 Vessels due by 10/12 of which 11 containers, 7 general cargo, 1 fertiliser, 2 export loaders, 1 cement, 2 tankers. No berthing delays. Port working normally.

INDIA, Dec 3 - Bombay - No labour problems. Three vessels loading at berth, 12 discharging at berth. 2 Vessels discharging at anchorage, 4 vessels waiting at anchorage to load, 4 waiting to discharge, 2 vessels bunkering. 5 Under repair, 2 awaiting orders. Berthing delays, container vessels, 2-3 days, bulkers 10-12 days, general cargo 3-4 days. Calcutta - Six vessels loading at berth, 12 discharging at berth, 1 vessel discharging at anchorage, 2 vessels bunkering. 18 Vessels due of which 4 coal, 6 products tankers, 5 containers, 2 coal, 1 lash). Cochin - No labour problems. Six vessels loading at berth, 6 discharging at berth. 2 Vessels waiting at anchorage to discharge, 1 fishing vessel, 2 small craft at dry-dock, 1 vessel waiting at shipyard jetty for repairs. 5 Vessels due with 1-2 days delay expected.

Mormugao - Nine vessels loading at berth, 3 waiting at anchorage to load, 1 waiting to discharge, 1 vessel bunkering. 4 under repair/dry-docked, 1 vessel awaiting orders, 12 due with 4-5 days delay expected. Kandla - Five vessels waiting at anchorage to load, 3 tankers. 12 Vessels due with 8-10 days delay expected. Mangalore - No labour problems. Seven vessels loading/discharging at berth, 3 waiting, 11 due with 1-2 days delay expected . Madras - No labour problems. Three vessels loading at berth, 15 discharging at berth, 2 waiting at anchorage to load, 20 waiting to discharge. 27 Vessels due by 3/12 of which 8 containers, 7 general cargo, 2 panamax, 1 phosphoric acid, 4 coal, 2 iron ore, 1 lube oil, 1 stone, 1 other vessel. Delays, coal/coke 5 days, fertiliser 4-5 days, scrap 5-6 days, containers 1-2 days, iron ore 1 day, other vessels 2-3 days.

Jawaharlal Nehru - No labour problems. One vessel loading at berth, 2 discharging at berth (fertiliser/raw materials). 1 Fertiliser/raw materials, 1 tanker/iron ore vessel due, with 1-2 days delay expected for tanker/iron ore vessel. Paradip - No labour problems. One vessel loading at berth, 1 discharging at berth, 1 waiting at anchorage to discharge. 8 Vessels due (4 coal, 2 chrome, 1 fertiliser, 1 chemicals), with no delays expected. Tuticorin - No labour problems. Three vessels loading at berth, 5 discharging at berth, 1 discharging at anchorage, 3 waiting at anchorage to discharge. 5 Vessels due with 1-2 days delay at present. Visakhapatnam - Four vessels loading at berth, 7 discharging at berth, 11 waiting at anchorage to discharge at inner harbour berths. 12 Vessels due with 7-8 days delay expected. No vessel designated to lift bunkers. Any bunkers required can be supplied at cargo berths at inner/outer harbour by barge or truck.

MALAYSIA, Dec 4 - Port Kelang - North port - Container berths - 8 Vessels alongside, 8 waiting. Deep draft conventional wharf - 4 Vessels alongside, 1 berthed, 4 waiting with waiting time of 3 days. Dry bulk terminal - 1 vessel alongside, 1 waiting with waiting time of 2 days. West port - 2 Container vessels alongside, 4 conventional vessels alongside, 2 cement carriers discharging. 2 wharves occupied by passenger vessel, 2 days waiting time.

MAURITIUS - Port Louis - Six vessels operating of which 2 containers discharging/loading, 4 general cargo discharging, 1 container vessel awaiting berth, 1 general cargo vessel waiting to discharge. Fishing port - 6 Vessels discharging and bunkering. Dry-dock - 1 Vessel.

PAKISTAN, Dec 2 - Karachi - Three vessels loading at berth (rice, chrome). 5 Container vessels loading/discharging at berth. 8 Vessels discharging at berth (general cargo, urea, dap, palm oil). 1 Rice vessel waiting at anchorage to load. 5 Vessels waiting at anchorage to discharge (fertiliser, oil tanker, hsd). 4 Vessels awaiting orders, 4 due with up to 24 hours delay expected. Port Qasim - Seven vessels discharging at berths (including fotco and iocberths) of which 1 chemicals, 1 soya beans, 1 pig-iron, 1 wheat, 1 steel slabs, 1 iron ore, 1 fuel oil. 5 Vessels waiting at anchorage to discharge (sugar, palm oil, iron ore, wheat).
PHILIPPINES, Dec 2 - Manila - South harbour - 10 Vessels discharging at berth, 7 discharging at anchorage, no berthing delays.

SIERRA LEONE, Dec 2 - Freetown - Two vessels operating at berth of which 1 aid cargo discharger, 1 cargo vessel under repair, 1 cargo vessel anchored under arrest. 5 Vessels due of which 1 container discharger, 1 bauxite loader, 1 general cargo discharger, 1 fertiliser dischger, 1 container/vehicles discharger, no delays expected. No labour problems. For security reasons vessels must endeavour to be in/out of port before 19.00 hrs.

SINGAPORE, Dec 2 - Singapore - Tanjong pagar container terminal - 7 Container vessels berthed. Keppel terminal - 10 Container/general cargo vessels berthed. Pasir Panjang terminal - 5 Container/general cargo vessels berthed. Sembawang terminal - 6 General cargo vessels berthed. Jurong port - 12 bulk cargo/steel/geral cargo vessels berthed. Oil terminals/sbm buoys - 3 Tankers berthed, minimal berthing delays at all terminals/buoys/ports.

SOUTH KOREA, Dec 3 - Inchon - 85 Vessels in port (44 berthed, 41 anchored) of which berthed, 9 logs, 8 general cargo, 5 containers, 4 corn, 3 steel, 3 cars, 2 pig-iron, 2 wheat, 1 ammonium hydroxide, 1 soybean meal, 1 palm oil, 1 steel plate, 1 salt, 1 raw sugar, 1 silica sand, 1 soda. Vessels anchored, logs, 5 steel, 4 general cargo, 4 containers, 3 coils, 2 wheat, 2 cars, 1 corn, 1 raw sugar, 1 bananas, 1 ply-wood, 1 peanuts, 1 sesame, 1 clay, 1 scrap, 1 pulp, 1 sulphate, 1 tapioca, 1 rape seed meal, 1 pig iron, approx. 1-2 days delay expected. Busan - 170 Vessels in port (52 berthed, 122 anchored , including 61 laid-up) of which berthed, 36 general cargo, 9 containers, 4 scrap, 3 coal. 61 Vessels awaiting berths, approx. 2 days delay expected.

Pohang - Fifteen vessels in port (12 berthed, 3 anchored), of which discharging, 4 coal, 2 scrap, 1 iron ore, 1 pipes, 1 ferro-silicon, 1 slabs. 2 Steel vessels loading, 3 vessels awaiting berths, approx. 2 days delay expected. Ulsan - 26 vessels in port (22 berthed, 4 anchored) of which discharging, 2 npk, 2 crude oil, 1 gypsum, 1 styrene monomer, 1 mono ethyl glycol, 1 raw sugar, 1 wood-chips, 1 copper, 1 urea, 1 mop, 1 propane, 1 corn, 1 phosphate/ore. Vessels loading, 3 general cargo, 2 amsul, 1 cosol, 1 kerosene. 4 Vessels awaiting berths with approx. 2 days delay expected. Masan - Eight vessels in port (all berthed) of which discharging, 2 steel scrap, 1 tapioca, 1 containers, 1 steel slabs, 1 frozen tuna. Vessels loading, 1 coaches, 1 cars, no berthing delays expected.

SRI LANKA, Dec 3 - Colombo - 17 Vessels loading at berth (12 containers, 5 essential services). 24 Discharging at berth (1 bagged sugar, 1 bagged rice, 2 general cargo, 1 bagged flour, 12 containers, 3 bagged urea, 2 bagged maize, 1 bulk lpg, 1 ro/ro. 9 Vessels waiting at anchorage to discharge (4 bagged fertiliser, 1 bulk palm oil, 1 newsprint, 1 bagged flour, 2 bagged rice). 4 To discharge/load containers. 3 Vessels bunkering, 4 under repair/dry-docked, 5 awaiting orders. 4 Vessels due of which 3 containers, 1 ro/ro, with 2-3 days delay expected for conventional vessels. Galle - One vessel discharging at berth. Trincomalee - One vessel discharging at berth, 1 loading at berth.

TAIWAN, Nov 30 - Keelung - Three vessels anchored. Berthing delays, grain 3 days, coal 4 days, steel/iron ore 2 days. Kaohsiung - Three vessels anchored. Berthing delays, grain/steel 1 day, coal/scrap 1 day (public berth), iron/coal 4 days (csc berth). Taichung - Six vessels anchored. Berthing delays grain 4-5 days, iron ore/coal/sap/steel 1 day, other vessels 1-2 days. Keelung, Dec 2 - 25 Vessels in port of which 11 containers, 3 tankers, 9 other bulkers, 2 general cargo. No vessels waiting at outer anchorage, no berthing delays. Kaohsiung, Dec 3 - 61 Vessels in port of which 10 containers, 5 tankers, 1 grain, 1 other bulker, 32 general cargo. 12 At buoys, no vessels waiting at outer anchorage, no delays.
